description:
Cast Cultivator Colossus by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
When Cultivator Colossus enters, it triggers, attempting to put Lake of the Dead from your hand onto the battlefield. Choose to instead put Lake of the Dead into your graveyard.
Afterwards, continue resolving the Cultivator Colossus trigger, causing you to mill two cards and return Lake of the Dead from your graveyard to your hand due to its dredge ability. Then, repeat the process, attempting to put Lake of the Dead from your hand onto the battlefield. Choose to instead put Lake of the Dead into your graveyard.
Repeat step 3.
